a.name: Soft grass brush
a.desc: A light, quick swish of a foot pressing into soft grass.
a.note: Kenney impact-sounds footstep_grass_001: instant transient then ~140 ms of airy grass rustle, nothing below the step; cut 190 ms so it never rings on.

b.name: Leather boot on earth
b.desc: A plain leather boot stepping on soft earth.

c.name: Heavy step on turf
c.desc: A firmer, heavier footfall thudding into earth and grass.
c.note: Freesound 'Stomping Footsteps on Grass' raw, the step at 20.35 s: low earth thud with grass crunch, peak at ~15 ms, decays by 200 ms.

layers.credit: "Stomping Footsteps on Grass" by sillygrizzlies, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/sillygrizzlies/sounds/635057

a.name: Soft muddy squish
a.desc: A soft, dull squish, like stepping into thick wet muck.
a.note: Kenney footstep_snow_002 pitched -4 st and lowpassed at 3.5 kHz: the snow crunch turns into a dull, mushy squish; loudest at ~21 ms.

b.name: Boot in deep mud
b.desc: A heavy boot sinking into mud with a wet squelch.
b.note: Freesound 'Footsteps_Mountain_Boots_Mud_Mono' raw step at 9.5 s (boot strike with wet tail, lowpassed 5.5 kHz to darken the field hiss) plus a 'Feet Squelch' burst (lowpassed 4.5 kHz, -4 dB) 10 ms later for the sucking wetness.

c.name: Splash in bog water
c.desc: A foot splashing down into shallow, muddy bog water.
c.note: Freesound 'Step into water puddle / wade' (splashy, pitched -2 st for weight) over a low wet thud from 'Wet Footsteps 1 Front' at -5 dB; all over by 200 ms.

layers.credit: "Step into water puddle / wade" by Breviceps, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/Breviceps/sounds/450621

a.name: Hard stone tap
a.desc: A short, clean tap of a boot on hard stone, with fine grit.
a.note: Kenney footstep_concrete_002 pitched -2 st (hard heel click) landing 3 ms after a quiet gravel crunch layer (-9 dB) that adds ash grit and keeps the very first sample soft; 127 ms total.

b.name: Boot on flagstone
b.desc: A leather boot heel landing on a stone floor, slight scrape.
b.note: Freesound 'Footsteps Stone (11)': heel strike peak at ~9 ms then a soft sole scrape to 220 ms; recorded on real stone, mid-heavy.

c.name: Gritty ash crunch
c.desc: A crunchy step on loose gravel, ash and rubble.
c.note: Freesound 'footsteps - gravel 02': two quick crunch transients in the first 50 ms, then light grit; reads as rubble and ash under foot.

a.name: Dark orchestra stab
a.desc: A sudden, dark orchestral stab, like a horror film jolt.
a.note: Library hit/fs-578374-shock-stab-04-1 (orchestral shock stab, rise 24 ms, low tonal body); cut to 600 ms with a 300 ms fade so only the jolt remains.

b.name: Ringing steel sting
b.desc: A sharp, ringing metal clang over a deep drum hit.
b.note: Library hit/fs-198114-clang-3-1 (trailer metal clang, 1 ms attack, ringing partials at 4-6 kHz) over hit/fs-573245-dark-timpani-1 at -4 dB for weight; cut 600 ms.

c.name: Monster snarl
c.desc: A sudden beastly snarl with a heavy thump underneath.
c.note: Freesound 'Monster snarl 3' pitched -2 st (a real voiced creature snarl) plus library hit/fs-276600-body-hit for an instant thump so the loudest point lands at ~31 ms.

a.name: Soft turning swish
a.desc: A soft cloth swirl as something turns away, then fading air.
a.note: Library swish/fs-718668-wrapping-cloth-2 (real cloth movement, first 60 ms trimmed, -2 st) over whoosh/fs-449995-whoosh-med-low at -5 dB (-3 st, lowpassed 3 kHz) for the fading air; peak ~140 ms, cut at 540 ms with a 280 ms fade so the cloth's own end is faded out.

b.name: Ghostly fading sigh
b.desc: A long, airy, ghostly whoosh drifting off into silence.
b.note: Library transition/fs-522693-arrow-ghost-pass-whoosh, first 130 ms trimmed, pitched -3 st, lowpassed 5 kHz; peak ~170 ms, long 400 ms fade.

c.name: Growl fading off
c.desc: A low growl that sinks and fades as it gives up.
c.note: Freesound 'Monster Roar 02' pitched -2 st and lowpassed 3 kHz (distant, muffled) with a soft low whoosh (fs-449992) at -6 dB for the turn-away; peak ~60 ms, decays over 800 ms. Family of enemy_notice c.

a.name: Low horn blast
a.desc: A deep, dark horn sounds and slowly fades.
a.note: Library hit/fs-592066-horns-edited-1-3 (layered brass horns), pitched -2 st and lowpassed 3 kHz so it sits far away; sustained with a second swell at 1.2 s, 700 ms fade.

b.name: Distant bell toll
b.desc: One slow, far-off church bell toll fading into cold air.
b.note: Freesound 'Gothic church bells' raw, the toll at 4.2 s, pitched -2 st and lowpassed 3.5 kHz; under it the cold cave reverb tail of hit/fs-130855-cold-cave-a at -8 dB.

c.name: Distant thunder rumble
c.desc: A low roll of far-off thunder rumbling through the place.
c.note: Library boom/fs-581124-distant-thunder-3-3 (real distant thunder) with hit/fs-130855-cold-cave-a at -4 dB for a hollow, cave-like air; rumbles and fades over 1.9 s.

a.name: Dark brass fanfare
a.desc: A short, dark brass fanfare with a drum hit and chimes.
a.note: Library hit/fs-592096-triumph-tada-horns-1 pitched -3 st (triumph turned grim) + dark timpani hit (fs-573245) for the impact + fs-389789-chimes-3 at -10 dB entering at 120 ms as the shimmer. Bigger take on zone_enter a. Cut at 1.85 s with a 750 ms fade so the chime layer's end (1.68 s) is already faded.

b.name: Great gong and bell
b.desc: A huge gong strike ringing out, topped with a bright bell.
b.note: Freesound 'gong hit loud close' (2 ms attack, long bronze bloom) + library chime/fs-185822-single-chime-1 at -10 dB, 80 ms later, as the old bell shimmer. Bigger take on zone_enter b.

layers.credit: "gong hit loud close.wav" by thma, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/thma/sounds/245878

c.name: Orchestra hit and glimmer
c.desc: A deep orchestral boom followed by a magical glimmering shimmer.
c.note: Library hit/fs-559391-orchestral-hit-1 (deep, wide orchestral impact) + shimmer/fs-521873-glimmer at -13 dB from 60 ms for the reward sparkle. Bigger take on zone_enter c.
